```{python}
#| output: asis
import math
import re
from datetime import date, datetime
from html import escape as e
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

notes = []
for path in Path(".").glob("*.qmd"):
    if path.name == "index.qmd":
        continue
    _, front, body = path.read_text().split("---", 2)
    meta = yaml.safe_load(front)
    prose = re.sub(r"```.*?```", lambda m: " ".join(re.findall(r'fig-cap: "(.*?)"', m.group(0))), body, flags=re.S)
    prose = re.sub(r"\$\$.*?\$\$", "", prose, flags=re.S)
    when = meta["date"] if isinstance(meta["date"], date) else datetime.strptime(meta["date"], "%Y-%m-%d").date()
    notes.append({
        "url": path.with_suffix(".html").name,
        "title": meta["title"],
        "description": meta.get("description", ""),
        "date": when,
        "tags": meta.get("categories", []),
        "minutes": max(1, math.ceil(len(re.findall(r"\w+", prose)) / 200)),
    })

items = []
for n in sorted(notes, key=lambda n: n["date"], reverse=True):
    tags = "".join(f"<span>{e(t)}</span>" for t in n["tags"])
    items.append(f"""<li>
<a class="note-title" href="{e(n['url'])}">{e(n['title'])}</a>
<p>{e(n['description'])}</p>
<p class="meta"><time datetime="{n['date']}">{n['date']:%B} {n['date'].day}, {n['date'].year}</time> · {n['minutes']} min read{tags}</p>
</li>""")

print("```{=html}\n<p>Short, visual explanations of topics I work on, written to be readable without a technical background.</p>\n<ul class=\"notes\">\n" + "\n".join(items) + "\n</ul>\n```")
```
